import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize_scalar
N=14
r=np.arange(-N,N+1)
I,J=np.meshgrid(r,r);I=I.ravel();J=J.ravel()
m=(I!=0)|(J!=0);I=I[m];J=J[m]
def E(y,nu,x=0.0):
    z=(I+J*(x+1j*y))/np.sqrt(y)
    a=np.abs(z)
    # log product matrix
    d=np.abs(z[:,None]-z[None,:]);np.fill_diagonal(d,np.inf)
    L=np.log(a)[:,None]+np.log(a)[None,:]+np.log(d)
    mn=L.min()
    return (mn*-nu)+np.log(np.exp(-nu*(L-mn)).sum())*1
for nu in [20,40,80,160]:
    r_=minimize_scalar(lambda y:E(y,nu),bounds=(1.0,1.6),method='bounded',options={'xatol':1e-10})
    print(nu,r_.x)
